newsitem.title: DUBAI: Omani stocks clock up strong gains in the week.
newsitem.headline: Omani stocks clock up strong gains in the week.

text.p: Oman's stock exchange clocked up strong gains in the week to Wednesday, with buying interest focused on banks and investment firms, a market report said.
The Muscat Securities Market said the index rose to 252.53 points from last week's 248.37 points.
The value of the week's total trade fell to 19.6 million rials ($52 million) from 34.52 million rials the previous close, it said.
Some 6.6 million shares changed hands in 2925 deals compared with last week's 11.55 million shares.
Of the 68 companies traded, 22 rose, 13 were steady and 23 fell.
Oman Raysut Cement Co was among this week's major gainers, closing at 4.200 rials from 3.730 rials last week.
The banking and investment sectors accounted for 76 percent of the week's total trade value.
